cd "$(pwd)" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from src.util import slugify
print("__doc__ present:", slugify.__doc__ is not None)
print(repr(slugify.__doc__))
print("--- behaviour against the docstring's claims ---")
cases = ["Hello, World!", "  Mixed CASE  ", "a---b", "--x--", "!!!", "", "Ünïcode Stuff", "already-a-slug", "a1b2"]
for c in cases:
    print(repr(c), "->", repr(slugify(c)))
# claims: lowercased result, only a-z0-9-, no leading/trailing hyphen
import re
bad = []
for c in cases + ["A_B.C", "trailing---", "---leading", "tab\tsep", "new\nline"]:
    s = slugify(c)
    if s != s.lower(): bad.append((c, "not lowercase"))
    if re.search(r"[^a-z0-9-]", s): bad.append((c, "illegal char"))
    if s.startswith("-") or s.endswith("-"): bad.append((c, "edge hyphen"))
    if "--" in s: bad.append((c, "double hyphen"))
print("violations:", bad)
EOF
